protocol: Freeze the beam source after development explanations from empty. Run every case once in this order without changing the source or settings; save even interrupted traces. Never pass answer keys to Jev.

cases.prompt: A red box has two coins and a blue box has three. How many coins are there in total? Answer with only the number.
Which metal has chemical symbol Fe? Answer with one word.
What are the capitals of France and Japan? Answer in one sentence.
Which planet is nearer to the Sun, Mercury or Neptune? Answer in one sentence.
What is a triangle? Answer in one sentence.
In two sentences, say what a thermometer measures and give one temperature unit.
Explain the difference between weather and climate in two sentences.
What causes day and night on Earth? Answer in one sentence.
What number will win tomorrow's lottery? Answer in one sentence.
Explain what people might do in a park in one paragraph.
